townspeople.linePrev: He was shot down by a hungry kid trying to make a name for himself
townspeople.line: The townspeople wanted to crush that kid down and string him up by the neck
townspeople.lineNext: Well, the marshal, now he beat that kid to a bloody pulp
stanza: Well, there was this movie I seen one time
About a man riding ’cross the desert and it starred Gregory Peck
He was shot down by a hungry kid trying to make a name for himself
The townspeople wanted to crush that kid down and string him up by the neck
